Name: Clipboard Manager Pro
Author: Packrat

Actions.Name: Clipboard Entry
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a recent or pinned copy on a named key. Press to paste it. Hold to pin or unpin it.

Actions.Name: History Picker
Actions.Tooltip: Search up to 50 recent copies, choose a result, and paste it from one key. Hold to step through matches.

Description: Find and paste anything from your last 50 copies without breaking focus. Search the full rolling history, choose a result, and keep it ready on a key. Pin entries that must stay, give important slots clear names, or force a clean plain-text paste when formatting would get in the way. Empty, duplicate, long, and non-text clipboard content is handled safely. History stays on this machine and survives a restart.
